script:
QA_ROLE=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools none --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq 5
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" \
  --json '{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_ASSISTANT"}]}' --expect 4xx \
  --save F06.send-non-user-role/assistant  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq 5
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_ROLE/events" \
  --json '{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_ASSISTANT"}]}' --expect 4xx \
  --save F06.send-non-user-role/assistant-empty-log  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0 \
  --save F06.send-non-user-role/empty-log-count  # bug
